guidance_fy26.src: RTX earnings releases (Form 8-K Item 2.02, Ex. 99): 2026 outlook issued 27-Jan-2026 and raised 21-Apr-2026, 23-Jul-2026 and 20-Oct-2026. Only company-level ranges are printed in the SEC-filed releases.
guidance_fy26.history: 27-Jan-2026 (Q4-25 release): adjusted sales $92.0-93.0bn, organic growth 5-6%, adjusted EPS $6.60-6.80, FCF $8.25-8.75bn. 21-Apr-2026: sales $92.5-93.5bn, EPS $6.70-6.90 (organic and FCF confirmed). 23-Jul-2026: sales $95.0-96.0bn, organic 8-9%, EPS $7.10-7.25, FCF $8.50-8.75bn. 20-Oct-2026: sales $97.0-97.5bn, organic 10-11%, EPS $7.65-7.75, FCF $9.0-9.2bn.
guidance_fy26.not_on_edgar: Segment sales / margin outlooks, adjusted tax rate, interest, pension, capex and share-count assumptions were given on the earnings calls / slides, which are not filed on EDGAR (rtx.com is blocked). The model does not use them; its point estimates for those items are labelled assumptions.

q3_26_facts.ieepa: IEEPA tariff refunds: ~$0.5bn of tariffs paid since inception; ~$0.4bn of approved refunds recognised and ~$0.3bn received at 30-Sep-2026 (Q3-26: ~$250m Collins, ~$160m Pratt & Whitney operating profit; $0.25 of adjusted EPS). Not adjusted out of adjusted results.
q3_26_facts.backlog: Backlog $340bn at 30-Sep-2026 (commercial $176bn, defense $164bn; Raytheon $130bn); $268bn at 31-Dec-2025. Q3-26 defense bookings ~$59bn incl. Tomahawk (~$23bn) and AMRAAM (~$14.3bn) multi-year awards.
q3_26_facts.pw_bankruptcy: Q3-26 net pre-tax charge ~$0.4bn ($363m) for a customer bankruptcy at Pratt & Whitney (contract-asset exposures); adjusted out.

amort_sched.src: Q3-26 10-Q Note 6 (intangible assets): expected amortization of intangible assets for the remainder of 2026 through 2031

debt.src: Q3-26 10-Q Note 9 (Borrowings and Lines of Credit) and MD&A Liquidity
debt.revolver: $5.0bn revolving credit agreement renewed Aug-2026 (expires Aug-2031), undrawn; commercial paper program up to $5.0bn backed by it, nil outstanding at 30-Sep-2026.
debt.q4_26_maturities: 2.650% notes ($719m), 3-month SOFR + 1.225% term loan ($900m) and 5.750% notes ($1,250m) due 2026 (current portion $5,679m at 30-Sep-2026 also includes 2027 maturities).

buyback.program: Board authorization of 21-Oct-2023 for up to $11bn (includes the $10bn ASR of Oct-2023); ~$0.6bn ($615m) remaining at 30-Sep-2026; no repurchases in 9M-26 (9M-25: $50m).

dividends.note: Quarterly dividend $0.68 declared 6-Feb-2026 (payable Mar-2026); raised to $0.73 in Apr-2026 (Q2-26 declared $1.46 = two quarterly dividends of $0.73: Jun and Sep payments); no declaration in Q3-26. Q4/26E assumes $0.73 declared (payable Mar-2027), as in Q4-25 ($0.68).

pension.src: FY2025 10-K Note 12 and MD&A; Q3-26 10-Q FAS/CAS operating adjustment table
pension.note: 2025: FAS/CAS operating adjustment $753m (CAS expense $873m − FAS service cost $120m); non-service pension income $1,182m (incl. a ~$0.3bn non-cash settlement charge on the Q4-25 Prudential annuity buy-out, adjusted out); plans 101% funded ($45.1bn assets vs $44.5bn PBO); 2026 cash funding ~$0.3bn. 9M-26: FAS/CAS $514m (CAS $600m − FAS service $86m); non-service pension income $1,048m.

price.src: Form 4 filed 3-Nov-2026 (accession 0001225208-26-008630; reporting person Dantaya M. Williams): open-market sale of 9,071 shares on 30-Oct-2026 at a weighted average $201.6951 (withholding disposition at $201.62 the same day). Latest share price in an SEC filing; update to market.

restructuring.note: Restructuring costs 2024 $71m, 2025 $246m, 9M-26 $65m net (incl. credits). No restructuring plan with a disclosed total is filed; the 2027E+ input ($200m falling to $150m p.a.) is an assumption.

cf_quarter_override.src: Three-month ("Quarter Ended") columns of the condensed cash-flow statements in each quarter's release (8-K Ex. 99); used where 9M − H1 / FY − 9M would mix presentation bases.

Q2-15.why: Q1-15 and H1-15 statements as originally reported differ slightly in capex classification; quarter column used.

Q3-15.why: Sikorsky moved to discontinued operations in the Q3-15 statement while the H1-15 statement included it (9M − H1 mixes bases); "restricted" = cash of assets held for sale ($16m).

Q3-16.why: The Q3-16 nine-month statement re-presents H1-16 cash flows (2016 adoption of ASU 2016-15); quarter column used.

Q4-16.why: The FY2016 statement includes restricted cash (ASU 2016-18 early adoption) while the 9M-16 statement did not; quarter column used (beginning cash $7,134m incl. restricted cash).

Q2-20.why: Otis and Carrier moved to discontinued operations in the Q2-20 statement while the Q1-20 statement (standalone UTC) included them; quarter column used. Beginning cash 8,066 = 6,073 + 1,993 held within discontinued operations; acquisitions = cash acquired in the Raytheon merger (+3,208); other operating includes the 3,183 goodwill impairment.
